mapper.insert: insert into review (user_id, item_id, order_id, rating, content, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{itemId}, #{orderId}, #{rating}, #{content}, #{createTime})
mapper.delete:
delete from review where id in
#{id}
mapper.select: select date(create_time) as date, count(*) as count from review where create_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval #{days} day) group by date(create_time) order by date(create_time)

sql.if: and (o.item_name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or i.name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or u.name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or r.content like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or r.reply_content like concat('%',#{keyword},'%'))
and r.reply_content is not null and r.reply_content != ''

mapper.select: select max(r.id) from review r left join user u on r.user_id = u.id left join explore_order o on r.order_id = o.id left join explore_item i on r.item_id = i.id
